edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner during the Owned constructor.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using caller-controlled amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the caller.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] and requires caller allowance.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before ownership can be reassigned.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete the handover.
onlyOwner gates the arbitrary external token transfer performed by the owner.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval call.
balances mapping is read and written by transfer.
balances mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner] directly.
approve overwrites the nested allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements the nested allowance mapping.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall overwrites the nested allowance mapping before the external call.
_totalSupply is the left operand of the subtraction in totalSupply().
balances[address(0)] is subtracted in totalSupply().
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the hard-coded initial supply constant.
Constructor credits the entire supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
_totalSupply - balances[address(0)] is executed without SafeMath, an unchecked subtraction.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary spender contract after writing the allowance.
The external call enters receiveApproval on attacker-controlled code, which may re-enter the token.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary tokenAddress contract.
Rescued tokens are always sent to the privileged owner address.
transfer recipient parameter determines the credited balance entry.
transfer amount parameter is the value moved between balances.
approve spender parameter keys the allowance mapping entry.
approve tokens parameter is the allowance value written.
transferFrom source parameter is debited without further authorisation logic beyond allowance.
transferFrom recipient parameter receives the credited tokens.
transferFrom amount parameter drives the balance and allowance debits.
approveAndCall spender parameter is both allowance key and call target.
approveAndCall tokens parameter is the allowance value written.
approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded into the external callback.
Spender parameter becomes the contract address invoked by the external call.
Arbitrary data parameter is passed into the external receiveApproval invocation.
tokenAddress parameter determines the external contract that is called.
tokens parameter is the amount requested from the external token contract.
Attacker-influenced tokenAddress becomes the target of the ERC20 external call.
New owner candidate is staged in newOwner by the owner-only function.
receiveApproval from parameter carries the original owner address.
receiveApproval tokens parameter carries the approved amount.
receiveApproval token parameter identifies the calling token contract.
receiveApproval data parameter is the unvalidated payload supplied by the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to select the credited balance entry inside transfer.
Transfer amount parameter has no independent semantics outside transfer.
Spender parameter only keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
Allowance value parameter is consumed only by approve.
Source account parameter is only meaningful within the transferFrom debit.
Recipient parameter only selects the credited balance inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives the balance and allowance debits of transferFrom.
Spender parameter is the allowance key and the external call target for approveAndCall.
Allowance amount parameter is written only by approveAndCall.
Arbitrary payload parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external callback, the reentrancy vector.
Parameter directly controls which external contract is invoked by the rescue call.
Amount parameter is only used to build the outgoing external call arguments.
Candidate owner parameter is stored straight into newOwner by the owner-only setter.
from parameter is part of the external callback ABI surface only.
tokens parameter is part of the external callback ABI surface only.
token parameter is part of the external callback ABI surface only.
data parameter is the untrusted payload delivered to the callback implementation.
